body_html:
Vish B, better known as DJ Catscratch, has been setting the vibe since 2002, bringing a rich history of DJing to every event he touches. Born in Queens, NY, Vish was introduced to the art of DJing at a young age, following in the footsteps of his father, who was also a DJ. This early exposure fueled his passion for music, and he’s been spinning tracks ever since.

Vish thrives on the joy and excitement that music brings to people, and he takes pride in delivering that energy to special events. While his favorite gigs are weddings and birthdays, his versatility shines through in the variety of events he’s mastered, including corporate events, school dances, mitzvahs, trivia nights, and more. Some of his go-to tracks that never fail to fill the dance floor include “Yeah” by Usher, “We Found Love” by Rihanna, and “Billie Jean” by Michael Jackson.

Beyond DJing, Vish enjoys tennis, running, and was a drummer during his college days. His eclectic taste in music spans Top 40, Hip Hop, Rock & Pop, EDM, and Caribbean beats, ensuring a diverse and engaging playlist that resonates with any audience. Whether you’re planning a wedding, mitzvah, corporate event, or school dance, DJ Catscratch is ready to make your event unforgettable with his seasoned expertise and infectious energy.
